Title: Standard Load Balancers in Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)

Body.Content:
Standard Load Balancers in AKS are now generally available, and production grade support is available. In addition, you no longer need to use an IP address assigned by the AKS service for your Standard Load Balancer. Now it’s possible to bring your own IP addresses and IP prefixes, and to scale out the number of IPs assigned to the Standard Load Balancer.

Learn more
